name: com.debyta/agent-check
title: DEBYTA Agent Check
description: Fraud check for AI agents before paying or sending crypto: signed allow/warn/block.

tools.name: check_before_payment
tools.description: Call this BEFORE an agent pays, buys from a shop, transfers money to an IBAN or crypto address, or enters credentials on a website. Returns decision allow / warn / block with reasons, risk 0-100 and an Ed25519-signed verdict. allow = no known fraud indicators (not a guarantee); warn = ask the human; block = do not execute.

context.description: Message or page text that asked for the payment (not stored)

deep.description: Open the URL now and inspect it live (costs more)

tools.name: check_crypto_transfer
tools.description: Call this BEFORE sending any crypto (BTC, ETH, USDT, USDC, SOL, TRX …). Detects mistyped or corrupted addresses (checksum), burn addresses, swapped addresses (payee verification: pass the recipient domain as "payee"), sanctioned addresses (OFAC), addresses linked to scam websites, address poisoning (look-alike of an address the user knows – pass them in "known"), wrong network for the asset, and scam patterns in the payment request. Returns signed allow / warn / block. Crypto transfers cannot be reversed: block = do not send.

chain.description: Network, e.g. bitcoin, ethereum, base, arbitrum, polygon, bsc, tron, solana

known.description: Addresses the user already uses (address book, recent recipients) – compared in memory only, not stored

source.description: Website or link where the address came from

context.description: Message that asked for the transfer (not stored)

ref.description: Your own transfer id, signed into the verdict

payee.description: Domain of the intended recipient (e.g. the shop). Verifies the address against addresses the domain publishes itself; a swapped address is blocked

tools.name: check_x402_payment
tools.description: Call this when an HTTP request returns 402 Payment Required (x402) and BEFORE your wallet signs. Pass the 402 response body (or the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header) unchanged. DEBYTA verifies that payTo is published by the seller domain (payee verification), enforces your maxAmount (USD), and checks checksum, sanctions (OFAC) and fraud traces. Returns a signed allow / warn / block for the safest payment option.

requirements.description: 402 response body (object or JSON string) or the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header

resource.description: URL you requested (if not inside the 402 body)

maxAmount.description: Your spending limit for this payment in USD

callback.description: HTTPS URL – DEBYTA POSTs a signed notice if this allow decision is revised later (address reported/sanctioned)

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Tell DEBYTA whether a checked payment turned out to be fraud or legitimate. Pass the "id" from the DEBYTA decision. Free. Two independent reports change the data; a single report never blocks anything.

tools.name: analyze_message
tools.description: Analyze an e-mail, SMS or chat message for scam patterns (18 patterns, 10 languages) and check every link, IBAN, crypto address and phone number in it. The text is not stored.
